verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. Unity's marketing claims team collaboration ('Collaborate and iterate quickly with your team'), and Build Automation documents support for most popular version control systems, but that integration is on the CI/build side. Nothing in the pack covers how project files behave in version control or describes a built-in collaboration product. Missing for 10: documentation of text-serialized (diffable) scene/asset formats, scene/prefab merge tooling, a first-party version control or collaboration service, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of multi-person workflows.
